title: ConsentCrmResponse
description: A condensed view of consent information

consentBaseVersion.description: The consent base version associated with the consent

consentCode.description: The consent code of the base consent associated with the consent

consentId.description: The id of the Consent that has been consented

consentOrganisationId.description: The organisation that owns the Consent. Typically an 'Operatør'

createdByOrgId.description: The organisation through which the consent was given

customerNumber.description: Customer number, a unique identifier for the customer.

customerRef.description: Customer ref, a unique identifier for the customer within an organisation

fromStopPlace.description: The stop place where the customer’s journey started, in NeTEx format.

lineRef.description: Reference to the customers journey line, in NeTEx format

originalDatedServiceJourneyId.description: Unique Id for a specific Service Journey, in NeTEx format with ENT as operator

toStopPlace.description: The stop place where the customer’s journey ended, in NeTEx format.
